Title: Azure Stream Analytics tools for Visual Studio Code now supports Visual Studio Codespaces

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics tools for Visual Studio Code now supports Visual Studio Codespaces. 

Visual Studio Codespaces provides cloud-powered development environments for any activity, whether it's a long-term project, or a short-term task like reviewing a pull request. Work with these environments from Visual Studio Code or a browser-based editor that's accessible anywhere. You even have the ability to connect your own self-hosted environments to Visual Studio Codespaces at no cost by following these instructions:

  1. Follow the steps in the quickstart (only two steps) to create a Codespace.
  2. Install Azure Stream Analytics tools in Visual Studio Code or Visual Studio editor in the browser.
  3. Use the full features from Azure Stream Analytics tools to author, local test, or submit your job just like you do in regular Visual Studio Code.

Learn more about Visual Studio Codespaces.
